title: Uniform L¹ approximate identity for continuous compactly supported h: ∫⁻‖ρ⋆h − h‖ₑ ≤ ε for all normalized kernels supported in a small ball
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure, and let h : ℝⁿ → ℝ be continuous with compact support. For every ε > 0 there is r > 0 with the following property. Let ρ : ℝⁿ → ℝ satisfy ρ ≥ 0, ∫ρ = 1 and support ρ ⊆ B_r(0) (open ball); ρ need not be continuous. Let (ρ ⋆ h)(x) := ∫ ρ(t) h(x − t) dt (Mathlib's convolution with lsmul ℝ ℝ and volume). Then ∫⁻ ‖(ρ ⋆ h)(x) − h(x)‖ₑ dx ≤ ofReal(ε).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ), Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ρ : Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) → ∫ z, ρ z = 1 → support ρ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) r → ∫⁻ x, ‖convolution ρ h (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x - h x‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
